evidence: Recovery freezes the complete measurement snapshot in a project/action-scoped React Query entry with infinite GC; the parent prefers that snapshot over normal query data.

While recovery exists, the measurement query is disabled and mount, reconnect and focus refetching are false. Refresh and collection are also disabled; the explicit authoritative check uses fetchQuery directly.

Recovery is removed and the lock released only after mutation success or when an authoritative read returns a completed Plan with a Result. Failed and incomplete checks retain the exact frozen request.
The shared parent operation ref synchronously excludes collection and finalization, while equal stateVersion cache writes preserve the existing evidence snapshot.

The strict server function derives project and actor context, the Work service derives the Plan and provenance, and the core preserves exact retry, competing-winner, selected-confounder and reviewed-Observation protections.
